digest.component_or_area: Cloud adapter pagination stall propagation through fetcher enrichment handlers
propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall hierarchy and causing it to be missed by the three re-raise clauses in fetch_snapshot's enrichment handlers

fetch_snapshot's three enrichment blocks (parent, comment, issuelink) each contain an except BackendPaginationStallError re-raise followed by an except Exception fail-open, and Cloud stall errors fall through to the broad exception handler which logs a warning and degrades the snapshot

A stalled Cloud cursor raises RunawayPaginationError during enrichment but is silently swallowed, resulting in a degraded snapshot written without parent data, comment data, or issuelink data instead of propagating the error and aborting the pass

Changing RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError allows the existing three re-raise clauses to catch and propagate Cloud stalls correctly while preserving backward compatibility with existing except RunawayPaginationError and except RuntimeError sites

The fix is a one-line change in acli_graph.py with no modifications required to fetcher.py or existing test bodies, and the core type BackendPaginationStallError already has the necessary re-raise logic in place
